name: @w6w-apps/devin
description: Kick off Devin coding sessions, follow their progress, and manage the messages, attachments and secrets that feed them, over Cognition's Devin API v3.

w6w.longDescription:
Devin is Cognition's autonomous coding agent. This app drives the session-oriented API a workflow actually needs: create a session with a natural-language prompt, poll or fetch it, send follow-up messages into a running session, and list every session an organization has run.

Secrets and file attachments round out the surface — a secret can be referenced by a session so credentials never travel through a prompt, and an attachment can be uploaded ahead of time and linked into a session or a message.

Devin's REST API is deliberately small and entirely session-shaped: there is no endpoint for reading a diff, a file, or a commit directly. Everything Devin produces — code, pull requests, explanations — arrives as messages and pull-request links on the session object itself.
